newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade slow at $63 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade slow at $63 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Thursday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 100 slaughter steers and 600 heifers; 88,500 head confirmed for the week to date including 20,400 formulated cattle and 400 contract cattle to be shipped this week. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00.
